status: design-contract-only; no Gaia data or runtime adapter
serialization_rules: IDs are decimal strings; unknowns are explicit null/masks; numeric values must be finite; provider unknown fields survive in original source records

identity_rules.baseline_identity: hipparcos + ESA-1997-I/239 + HIP; component null unless independently established
identity_rules.foreign_identity: catalogue + release + source_id; never equate identifiers across releases
identity_rules.component_null: unknown or unresolved; not an asserted single star, barycentre or primary
identity_rules.cardinality: one membership row per original HIP; zero or more candidate counterparts; at most one explicitly adopted astrometric solution per component

membership.population: complete Stars.source_catalog before any chart selection
membership.chart_selection: existing magnitude cut OR explicit include_ids OR enabled constellation vertices; later visibility/detail selection remains independent
membership.outside_source: report absent explicit IDs and missing constellation endpoints; do not fabricate source rows or coordinates
membership.unmatched: retain original membership and source-native lookup; no implicit new propagation capability

solution_fields.reference: frame, origin, reference epoch value/format/scale, spatial convention and primary-source evidence
solution_fields.parameters: original names/values/units/masks for position, PM, parallax and radial velocity when supplied
solution_fields.uncertainty: parameter errors, all supplied correlations, covariance ordering/units and derivation when constructed; unknowns explicit
solution_fields.quality: solution type and preserved original quality fields; usability policy version and reasons
solution_fields.source: resource digest, row identity and provenance; original fields preserved

photometry.existing_magnitude: original Hipparcos visual magnitude used for selection and symbol sizing
photometry.gaia_bands: separate measurements with passband/release/source provenance; no implicit G-to-V substitution
